description: Reg. § 1.469-1T(f)(2)(i)(D) Example 1 (also Pub. 925): activities A (income 7,000, deductions 16,000: loss 9,000), B (4,000 − 20,000: loss 16,000) and C (12,000 − 8,000: income 4,000), all passive businesses. The $21,000 passive activity loss is disallowed ratably: A $21,000 x 9,000/25,000 = $7,560; B $21,000 x 16,000/25,000 = $13,440.
